infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SENTINEL uses the camera to scan strip QR codes and capture colorimetric strip images for exposure estimation.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: SENTINEL can optionally monitor motion to detect if a worker has been still for an unusually long time (dead man's switch) as an H2S safety feature.

plugins.cameraPermission: SENTINEL uses the camera to scan strip QR codes and capture colorimetric strip photos.

extra._comment_apiUrl: Leave apiUrl unset for the normal case (phone + laptop on the same Wi-Fi). src/config.ts auto-detects the LAN IP from Expo's own dev-server host. Only set apiUrl below to override that (e.g. a deployed/tunnelled backend).
